definitions.explanation: A portion of the circumference of a circle. Used in mathematics, engineering, and design to describe curved segments.

examples.japanese: {虹|にじ}は{大|おお}きな{円弧|えんこ}の{形|かたち}をしている。
examples.english: A rainbow has the shape of a large arc.

examples.japanese: コンパスを{使|つか}って{半径|はんけい}{五|ご}センチの{円弧|えんこ}を{引|ひ}きなさい。
examples.english: Use a compass to draw an arc with a radius of five centimeters.

notes:
Composed of {円|えん} (circle) and {弧|こ} (arc). A mathematical and technical term for a segment of a circle's circumference. Also used more loosely to describe any curved, arc-like shape.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {円弧|えんこ}を{描|えが}く: to draw/trace an arc
- {円弧|えんこ}の{長|なが}さ: arc length
- {円弧|えんこ}{状|じょう}: arc-shaped

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {弧|こ}: arc — the character alone, used in mathematics
- アーチ: arch — loanword; refers to architectural arches
- {曲線|きょくせん}: curve — a more general term for any curved line
- {弧|こ}{度|ど}: radian — the angular measure based on arc length
